summary: 短篇小说家凯瑟琳·曼斯菲尔德成长于新西兰，后来往来于英国和欧洲大陆。故乡记忆与旅居经历都进入作品，《幸福及其他故事》巩固了她的声誉，身后还有遗作陆续出版。
logic: 惠灵顿童年与早期写作

paragraphs.brief: 惠灵顿郊区留下的童年记忆
sentences: Beauchamp Murry was born in 1888, into a prominent family in Wellington, New Zealand.
比彻姆·默里于 1888 年出生在新西兰惠灵顿的一个名门家庭。
She became one of New Zealand’s best-known writers, using the pen name of Katherine Mansfield.
她以“凯瑟琳·曼斯菲尔德”为笔名，后来成为新西兰最著名的作家之一。
The daughter of a banker, and born into a middle-class family, she was also a first cousin of Countess Elizabeth von Arnim, a distinguished novelist in her time.
她出身中产阶级，父亲是银行家，她的表亲伊丽莎白·冯·阿尼姆伯爵夫人也是当时有名的小说家。
Mansfield had two older sisters and a younger brother.
曼斯菲尔德有两个姐姐和一个弟弟。
Her father, Harold Beauchamp, went on to become the chairman of the Bank of New Zealand.
她的父亲哈罗德·比彻姆后来成了新西兰银行董事长。

In 1893 the Mansfield family moved to Karori, a suburb of Wellington, where Mansfield would spend the happiest years of her childhood; she later used her memories of this time as an inspiration for her Prelude story.
1893 年，全家迁到惠灵顿郊区卡罗里，曼斯菲尔德在那里度过童年最快乐的日子。后来，这段回忆成为她创作《序曲》的灵感。
paragraphs.gist: 曼斯菲尔德生于惠灵顿银行家家庭，童年迁往郊区卡罗里后度过的快乐时光，后来成为短篇小说《序曲》的灵感。

paragraphs.brief: 最早的发表与少年时期的兴趣
sentences: Her first published stories appeared in the High School Reporter and the Wellington Girls’ High School magazine in 1898 and 1899.
她最早发表的小说在 1898 年和 1899 年刊登于《高中通讯员》和惠灵顿女子高中的校刊上。
In 1902 she developed strong feelings for a musician who played the cello, Arnold Trowell, although her feelings were not, for the most part, returned.
1902 年，她深深爱上了大提琴手阿诺德·特罗韦尔，但这份感情大多没有得到对方回应。
Mansfield herself was an accomplished cellist, having received lessons from Trowell’s father.
曼斯菲尔德本人也是位出色的大提琴手，曾向特罗韦尔的父亲学琴。

Mansfield wrote in her journals of feeling isolated to some extent in New Zealand, and, in general terms, of her interest in the Maori people (New Zealand’s native people), who were often portrayed in a sympathetic light in her later stories, such as How Pearl Button Was Kidnapped.
她在日记中写到，自己在新西兰多少有些孤立，也略谈了自己对当地原住民毛利人的兴趣。她后来的小说常以富有同情心的笔触描绘毛利人，例如《珀尔·巴顿是怎样被绑架的》。
paragraphs.gist: 少年的曼斯菲尔德已在校刊发表小说并学习大提琴，她也把在故乡的孤独感和对毛利人的兴趣写进日记，后者后来进入她的小说。

paragraphs.brief: 女王学院的音乐和文学生活
sentences: She moved to London in 1903, where she attended Queen’s College, along with her two sisters.
1903 年，她搬到伦敦，与两个姐姐一起就读于女王学院。
Mansfield recommenced playing the cello, an occupation that she believed, during her time at Queen’s, she would take up professionally.
曼斯菲尔德重新开始拉大提琴。在女王学院求学期间，她一度相信自己以后会以此为职业。
She also began contributing to the college newspaper, with such a dedication to it that she eventually became its editor.
她还开始为校报撰稿，投入程度之深，使她最终当上了校报编辑。

She was particularly interested in the works of the French writers of this period and in the 19th-century British writer, Oscar Wilde, and she was appreciated amongst fellow students at Queen’s for her lively and charismatic approach to life and work.
她尤其喜爱同时代法国作家的作品，以及 19 世纪英国作家奥斯卡·王尔德的作品。女王学院的同学欣赏她对待生活与工作时的活力和魅力。
She met fellow writer Ida Baker, a South African, at the college, and the pair became lifelong friends.
在校期间，她结识了同样写作的南非人艾达·贝克，两人成为终身好友。
Mansfield did not become involved in much political activity when she lived in London.
住在伦敦期间，曼斯菲尔德很少参与政治活动。
For example, although at that time in London many women were demonstrating for votes for women, Mansfield did not actively support the suffragette movement in the UK.
例如，当时伦敦许多女性正为争取女性选举权而游行，她却没有积极支持英国的妇女参政运动。
Women in New Zealand had gained the right to vote in 1893.
新西兰女性早在 1893 年就赢得了投票权。
paragraphs.gist: 在伦敦女王学院，她曾想当职业大提琴手，却也热心编辑校报、阅读法英文学并结交终身好友，对当时的妇女参政运动则较少参与。

paragraphs.brief: 首次稿酬与再度离开故乡
sentences: Mansfield first began journeying into other parts of Europe in the period 1903–1906, mainly to Belgium and Germany.
1903 至 1906 年间，曼斯菲尔德开始到欧洲其他地区旅行，主要去了比利时和德国。
After finishing her schooling in England, she returned to her New Zealand home in 1906, only then beginning to write short stories in a serious way.
1906 年，她在英格兰完成学业后回到新西兰，直到那时才开始认真创作短篇小说。
She had several works published in Australia in a magazine called Native Companion, which was her first paid writing work, and by this time she had her mind set on becoming a professional writer.
她在澳大利亚的《本土伴侣》杂志上发表了几篇作品，第一次靠写作获得报酬。到这时，她已经决心成为职业作家。
It was also the first occasion on which she used the pseudonym ‘K. Mansfield’.
她也在这一次首次使用了“K. Mansfield”这个笔名。
Mansfield rapidly grew discontented with the provincial New Zealand lifestyle, and with her family.
曼斯菲尔德很快就对新西兰相对闭塞的生活方式以及自己的家人感到不满。
Two years later she headed again for London.
两年后，她再度前往伦敦。
Her father sent her an annual subsidy of £100 for the rest of her life.
此后直到她去世，父亲每年都会给她寄 100 英镑的生活补贴。
In later years, she would express both admiration and disdain for New Zealand in her journals.
在后来的日记中，她既表达过对新西兰的赞赏，也流露过轻蔑。
paragraphs.gist: 返乡后她开始认真写短篇小说，首次以笔名发表有稿酬的作品，两年后因不满当地生活再赴伦敦，对故乡始终抱有复杂感情。

paragraphs.brief: 与默里办刊及经济困境
sentences: In 1911, Mansfield met John Middleton Murry, the Oxford scholar and editor of the literary magazine Rhythm.
1911 年，曼斯菲尔德结识了牛津学者约翰·米德尔顿·默里，他也是文学杂志《节奏》的编辑。
They were later to marry, in 1918.
两人后来于 1918 年结婚。
Mansfield became a co-editor of Rhythm, which was subsequently called The Blue Review, in which more of her works were published.
曼斯菲尔德成为《节奏》的联合编辑。该刊后来改名为《蓝色评论》，并发表了她更多的作品。
She and Murry lived in various houses in England and briefly in Paris.
她和默里在英格兰住过好几个地方，也曾在巴黎短暂居住。
The Blue Review failed to gain enough readers and was no longer published.
由于吸引不到足够多的读者，《蓝色评论》最终停刊。
Their attempt to set up as writers in Paris was cut short by Murry’s bankruptcy, which resulted from the failure of this and other journals.
这本杂志及其他刊物的失败使默里破产，两人原打算在巴黎靠写作为生，这一尝试也被迫中止。
Life back in England meant frequently changed addresses and very limited funds.
回到英格兰后，他们常常搬家，手头也十分拮据。
paragraphs.gist: 曼斯菲尔德与日后的丈夫默里共同编辑文学刊物，杂志停刊和破产打断了两人在巴黎靠写作为生的计划，回英后仍频频搬家。

paragraphs.brief: 病中辗转与小说集成名
sentences: Between 1915 and 1918, Mansfield moved between England and Bandol, France.
1915 至 1918 年间，曼斯菲尔德往返于英格兰和法国班多尔。
She and Murry developed close contact with other well-known writers of the time such as D.H. Lawrence, Bertrand Russell and Aldous Huxley.
她和默里与当时其他知名作家交往密切，如 D. H. 劳伦斯、伯特兰·罗素和奥尔德斯·赫胥黎。
By October 1918 Mansfield had become seriously ill; she had been diagnosed with tuberculosis, and was advised to enter a sanatorium.
到 1918 年 10 月，她已病得很重。她被诊断出患有肺结核，医生建议她进疗养院。
She could no longer spend winters in London.
她再也不能留在伦敦过冬。
In the autumn of 1918 she was so ill that she decided to go to Ospedaletti in Italy.
1918 年秋天，她身体十分虚弱，于是决定前往意大利的奥斯佩达莱蒂。
It was the publication of Bliss and Other Stories in 1920 that was to solidify Mansfield’s reputation as a writer.
1920 年出版的《幸福及其他故事》巩固了她作为作家的声誉。
paragraphs.gist: 她一度往来英法并结识多位作家，肺结核迫使她另寻过冬之处，而 1920 年出版的《幸福及其他故事》巩固了她的文名。

paragraphs.brief: 在芒通别墅写成的八篇小说
sentences: Mansfield also spent time in Menton, France, as the tenant of her father’s cousin at ‘The Villa Isola Bella’.
曼斯菲尔德也曾住在法国芒通，租住父亲表亲的“伊索拉·贝拉别墅”。
There she wrote eight stories including Miss Brill and The Daughters of the Late Colonel, the latter of which she pronounced to be ‘…the only story that satisfies me to any extent’.
她在那里写了八篇小说，包括《布里尔小姐》和《已故上校的女儿们》。对于后者，她说那是“唯一一篇让我多少感到满意的小说”。
paragraphs.gist: 她在法国芒通租住亲戚的别墅期间写成八篇作品，其中《已故上校的女儿们》是少有的让她自己感到满意的小说。

paragraphs.brief: 丈夫整理与出版身后遗稿
sentences: Mansfield produced a great deal of work in the final years of her life, and much of her prose and poetry remained unpublished at her death in 1923.
曼斯菲尔德在生命的最后几年创作颇丰。她于 1923 年去世时，许多散文和诗歌仍未发表。
After her death her husband, Murry, took on the task of editing and publishing her works.
她去世后，丈夫默里承担起编辑和出版她作品的工作。

His efforts resulted in two additional volumes of short stories, The Dove’s Nest and Something Childish, published in 1923 and 1924 respectively, the publication of her Poems, as well as a collection of critical writings (Novels and Novelists) and a number of editions of Mansfield’s previously unpublished letters and journals.
在他的努力下，两本新的短篇小说集《鸽巢》和《孩子气的事》分别于 1923 年和 1924 年出版。其后还有她的《诗集》、评论集《小说与小说家》，以及多种版本的遗留书信和日记面世。
paragraphs.gist: 曼斯菲尔德去世时尚有不少遗稿，默里随后整理出版两本短篇集，并陆续推出她的诗歌、评论、书信和日记。

items.en: The name Katherine Mansfield, that appears on the writer’s books, was exactly the same as her original name.
items.zh: 书上署的「凯瑟琳·曼斯菲尔德」，与这位作家原来的姓名完全相同。
items.why: 书上使用的是凯瑟琳·曼斯菲尔德这个笔名，与她的原名并不完全相同。

items.en: Mansfield won a prize for a story she wrote for the High School Reporter.
items.zh: 曼斯菲尔德为《高中记者》撰写的一篇故事获了奖。
items.why: 文中交代了故事发表的刊物和年份，没有说作品是否获奖。

items.en: How Pearl Button Was Kidnapped portrayed Maori people in a favourable way.
items.zh: 《珀尔·巴顿是怎样被绑架的》对毛利人作了正面的描写。
items.why: sympathetic light = 以同情/正面的角度描写，相当于题干“favourable way”。

items.en: When Mansfield was at Queen’s College, she planned to be a professional writer.
items.zh: 在女王学院读书时，曼斯菲尔德打算成为职业作家。
items.why: 她在女王学院时想以演奏大提琴为业，题干把这段时期的志向说成了写作。

items.en: Mansfield was unpopular with the other students at Queen’s College.
items.zh: 曼斯菲尔德在女王学院的同学中不受欢迎。
items.why: 在女王学院，同学们欣赏曼斯菲尔德；题干却把她说成不受同学欢迎。

items.en: In London, Mansfield showed little interest in politics.
items.zh: 在伦敦期间，曼斯菲尔德对政治兴趣不大。
items.why: 她未积极支持英国的妇女参政运动，不能由这一个例子断定她对政治普遍缺乏兴趣。

items.en: In ________, Katherine Mansfield moved from England back to New Zealand.
items.zh: ________年，凯瑟琳·曼斯菲尔德从英格兰搬回新西兰。
items.why: 该年从英格兰回新西兰。

items.en: first paid writing work was in a publication based in ________
items.zh: 她第一篇获得稿酬的作品发表在一家总部位于________的刊物上。
items.why: 首次有报酬的写作发表于澳大利亚。

items.en: her ________ and the New Zealand way of life made her feel dissatisfied
items.zh: 她对自己的________和新西兰的生活方式都不满意。
items.why: 对“新西兰的生活方式和家人"不满。

items.en: ________ prevented Mansfield and Murry from staying longer in Paris
items.zh: 由于________，曼斯菲尔德和默里没能在巴黎多住一段时间。
items.why: “破产"使二人无法在巴黎常住、共同谋生。
与多位著名作家来往密切。

items.en: her ________ was consolidated when Bliss and Other Stories was published
items.zh: 《幸福及其他故事》出版后，她的________得到巩固。

items.en: Mansfield’s ________ published more of her works after her death
items.zh: 曼斯菲尔德去世后，她的________又出版了她的多部作品。
items.why: 她的丈夫在其身后继续出版其作品。

groups.instructionsZh: 先回想空格里的英文。每空填一个词，可含数字。

pairs: 以正面、理解的眼光看待
题干用形容词，定位句改用同词根的副词。
第 8 段 · 第 3 句
points: 她未积极支持英国的妇女参政运动，不能由这一个例子断定她对政治普遍缺乏兴趣。
与多位著名作家来往密切。
clauses: In 1902 she developed strong feelings for a musician who played the cello, Arnold Trowell, …, returned.
连接词 although 引出“although her feelings were not, for the most part”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 although 把这一层关系补进去。
It was also the first occasion … ’.
“on which she used the pseudonym ‘K. Mansfield”修饰前面的 occasion。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 which 时，回看 occasion，再把修饰信息接回主句。
lead: Katherine Mansfield was a modernist writer of short fiction who was born and brought up in New Zealand.
凯瑟琳·曼斯菲尔德是一位现代主义短篇小说作家，在新西兰出生、长大。
vocabulary: 地方性的；此处指生活相对闭塞
